issue.title: Javadoc Example Throws Unexpected Exception
issue.body: Verify(mockedList, atLeast(2)).add("five times"); - would throw org.mockito.exceptions.verification.TooLittleActualInvocations Correcting this would help to make sure new devs are not confused by the verify use case there.
